correctness.rationale: The divisor-support lemma identifies primes dividing the quotient exactly with two multiples in the window. CRT gives the Bernoulli model, exact PGF, and least period. PNT integrals yield mean/variance constants; bounded-summand Berry--Esseen proves the Gaussian limit; a truncated log-prime sum controlled by the classical PNT remainder proves the sign exponent. An independent finite exact quotient checker replayed 543 cases; these are not mistaken for proof.
